note: AETHERFALL (https://aetherfall.dev/) is capture-class: a Vite production build of an epic pixel-art fantasy MMO RPG served at the origin root behind Cloudflare (client v0.7.16). Structure decided from BYTES (tools/probe-structure.mjs, 2026-10-14): real import/export specifiers (the fx3d chunk imports its shared bindings from ./index-BTsv3a2s.js; the runtime dynamic-imports fx3d/hd2d through the entry's __vite__mapDeps table), zero module-factory signatures (no __webpack_require__/Turbopack), no sourceMappingURL and no *.map files — FLAT Vite production ES modules, so statement-aligned slices are the true boundary (the taipei-rush-tokyo / clawd-rpg flat-ESM precedent; the factory-family split is inapplicable). The capture preserves the served URL structure (index.html at the root + assets/ + audio/ under it), so the derived layers mirror it (PLAN §5 served-path paragraph): capture -> pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, iterated to a fixed point — the index chunk needs a second pass on one member-chain region; never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) -> readable/assets/<chunk>.pretty.js|css (the served path is the truth; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) -> statement-aligned slices src/assets/<chunk>-NN.js of every APP region (top-level declaration boundaries only, ~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range — through the recorded rename map where the slice is renamed. WholeFile sections, never sliced (vendor/machinery rule): the entry chunk's chunk-machinery head (__vite__mapDeps table, rollup CJS interop helpers, Vite modulepreload polyfill) and its bundled React 19.3.0 region (react + react-dom + scheduler CJS modules under the rollup require helper; the app resumes at the guarded class-table head), the bundled three.js r186 engine region inside assets/fx3d-DiRK8ozf.js (up to and including the WebGLRenderer class — the minifier merged the game's particle-shader/palette tables into the same declaration, so the wholeFile region carries them and the app resumes at the guarded palette color helper), the hd2d chunk's __vite__mapDeps head, the whole assets/GLTFLoader-MfgfXc7d.js vendor chunk (three.js addon), and the stylesheet assets/index-CrHozmsT.css (stylesheet rule). Non-standalone parts are skipped sections, indexed but never sliced: every app chunk's final export {…} table (the bindings live in the earlier slices; the recorded renameBindings reach the renamed ones at reconstruction time). Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html references external chunks only — zero inline content blocks, so there are no *-inline-N twins and no readable/index-inline-map.json. Rename layer (PLAN §5 campaign, closed 2026-10-14; pipeline apply -> recover -> derive -> gates): tools/names.json (reviewed) -> tools/apply-names.mjs -> rename-map.json (recovered mechanically by tools/recover-scoped-map.mjs) -> re-applied here on every re-cut through tools/engine/rename-layer.mjs (index-validated).
